lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial frequency observed near the anterior portion of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Numerous small, high-luminance blobs are distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed near the base and a more sparse arrangement towards the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge and distal tip of the visible pectoral fin exhibit a concentrated region of high-luminance white pixels, forming a distinct margin.
